capabilities.name: file.read
capabilities.description: Read a regular UTF-8 text file up to 100 KB

capabilities.name: file.write
capabilities.description: Create a NEW nonempty text file; never overwrite. Parent must exist.

capabilities.name: file.list
capabilities.description: List at most 200 allowed directory entries

capabilities.name: file.search
capabilities.description: Search filenames under a directory, optionally within an ISO modification-time range

capabilities.name: file.exists
capabilities.description: Check existence only when asked about existence. For read goals use file.read directly, which reports missing-path errors.

capabilities.name: browser.open
capabilities.description: Open a public URL in a task-owned browser and observe navigation

capabilities.name: browser.read
capabilities.description: Read a task-owned browser session using its observed session ID

capabilities.name: browser.search
capabilities.description: Open public web or YouTube search for a literal query

capabilities.name: desktop.launch
capabilities.description: Open an installed application by name; verify visible focused window

capabilities.name: desktop.focus
capabilities.description: Focus an already observed installed app; never launch a replacement

capabilities.name: system.status
capabilities.description: Observe current CPU, memory and disk probes

capabilities.name: system.storage
capabilities.description: Measure filesystem usage; highest is computed from measured percentages

capabilities.name: system.processes
capabilities.description: Observe bounded process names and IDs; no command lines

capabilities.name: task.inspect
capabilities.description: Inspect a persisted task by ID

capabilities.name: notification.send
capabilities.description: Create a policy-controlled notification record; approval required

capabilities.name: desktop.windows
capabilities.description: Observe authoritative GNOME windows; unavailable is an error

capabilities.name: desktop.observe
capabilities.description: Observe authoritative GNOME windows; unavailable is an error

capabilities.name: desktop.close
capabilities.description: Operate on an exact observed window ID and application identity

capabilities.name: desktop.move
capabilities.description: Operate on an exact observed window ID and application identity

capabilities.name: desktop.resize
capabilities.description: Operate on an exact observed window ID and application identity

capabilities.name: desktop.maximize
capabilities.description: Operate on an exact observed window ID and application identity

capabilities.name: desktop.unmaximize
capabilities.description: Operate on an exact observed window ID and application identity

capabilities.name: desktop.minimize
capabilities.description: Operate on an exact observed window ID and application identity

capabilities.name: desktop.tile
capabilities.description: Operate on an exact observed window ID and application identity. The rectangle is computed by the shell from the monitor work area and verified against the monitor scale factor, so a tile on a fractionally scaled display is not reported unconfirmed (ARIES_TILE_HIDPI)

capabilities.name: browser.tabs
capabilities.description: List only browser tabs owned by this task

capabilities.name: browser.observe
capabilities.description: Task-owned public browser observe; observe again after action. No credentials or POST.

capabilities.name: browser.elements
capabilities.description: Task-owned public browser elements; observe again after action. No credentials or POST.

capabilities.name: browser.navigate
capabilities.description: Task-owned public browser navigate; observe again after action. No credentials or POST.

capabilities.name: browser.click
capabilities.description: Task-owned public browser click; observe again after action. No credentials or POST.

capabilities.name: browser.type
capabilities.description: Task-owned public browser type; observe again after action. No credentials or POST.

capabilities.name: browser.scroll
capabilities.description: Task-owned public browser scroll; observe again after action. No credentials or POST.

capabilities.name: browser.back
capabilities.description: Task-owned public browser back; observe again after action. No credentials or POST.

capabilities.name: browser.forward
capabilities.description: Task-owned public browser forward; observe again after action. No credentials or POST.

capabilities.name: browser.wait
capabilities.description: Task-owned public browser wait; observe again after action. No credentials or POST.

capabilities.name: browser.download
capabilities.description: Download an observed public link into a NEW reviewed local path; pinned GET, 20 MB maximum

capabilities.name: file.metadata
capabilities.description: Inspect regular file size, timestamp and SHA-256 up to 20 MB

capabilities.name: file.copy
capabilities.description: Copy a reviewed source hash to a NEW destination; no overwrite

capabilities.name: file.semantic_search
capabilities.description: Bounded local filename/PDF/text relevance with metadata filters and explanations

capabilities.name: file.edit
capabilities.description: Replace exactly one text fragment after review of source SHA-256; advisory writer lock

capabilities.name: file.move
capabilities.description: Reviewed same-filesystem atomic move to a NEW path; existing destinations refused

capabilities.name: file.rename
capabilities.description: Reviewed same-filesystem atomic move to a NEW path; existing destinations refused

capabilities.name: network.status
capabilities.description: Observe connectivity: link, addresses, gateway, DNS, and separately whether the internet is actually reachable

capabilities.name: network.wifi_list
capabilities.description: List visible wifi networks with signal strength and which are already saved; no rescan is forced

capabilities.name: network.wifi_connect
capabilities.description: Bring up an ALREADY-SAVED connection by name; ARIES never accepts a wifi password

capabilities.name: display.brightness
capabilities.description: Read the screen brightness; reports every mechanism it probed and why none is available when this machine has no brightness control

capabilities.name: display.set_brightness
capabilities.description: Set the screen brightness to a percentage and re-read it; refuses with evidence when the hardware exposes no backlight

capabilities.name: screen.capture
capabilities.description: See the screen: capture the whole screen, or the area one observed window ID occupies, to an ARIES-owned PNG. A blanked screen or a uniform frame is an error, never a result.

capabilities.name: screen.screenshot
capabilities.description: See the screen: capture the whole screen, or the area one observed window ID occupies, to an ARIES-owned PNG. A blanked screen or a uniform frame is an error, never a result.

capabilities.name: screen.read
capabilities.description: Read what is on the screen: capture it and recover its text with local OCR in Macedonian and English. Use this to answer questions about what is displayed; refuses with instructions if OCR data is missing.

capabilities.name: system.services
capabilities.description: List systemd units with their real ActiveState/SubState and activation time, from the user and system managers. Read-only; a manager that cannot answer is named, not hidden.

capabilities.name: system.service
capabilities.description: Inspect ONE systemd unit by name. A name systemd does not know is an error, never an inactive unit.

capabilities.name: system.service_control
capabilities.description: Start, stop or restart ONE allowlisted user unit. System units are refused: they need an interactive administrator password. Verified by re-reading the unit; a new InvocationID is the proof, not an accepted job.

capabilities.name: system.disk
capabilities.description: Measure filesystem usage with statvfs and the largest directories under your home folder. Bounded by depth, entry count and time; a truncated walk says so.

capabilities.name: system.packages
capabilities.description: Check whether a package is installed and at what version, through dpkg and snap. Never installs anything.

capabilities.name: input.clipboard_read
capabilities.description: Read the current clipboard as text, bounded to 100 KB. Use it only when the user asks what is on the clipboard: it returns whatever they last copied, which may be a password, so never call it for context.

capabilities.name: input.clipboard_write
capabilities.description: Replace the clipboard with text and verify it by reading it back from a fresh session. The previous clipboard is destroyed and cannot be restored, so approval is required.

capabilities.name: input.editable_targets
capabilities.description: List one running application's editable text controls with the node identity input.type_text needs. Password fields are never listed. Call this first; a node path alone is not a target.

capabilities.name: input.type_text
capabilities.description: Insert text into ONE control previously reported by input.editable_targets, re-verifying its identity first. Refused unless it is still editable, enabled, focused, in the active window, free of a selection and not a password field. Terminals do not support this and are refused, not approximated. Any text that would arrive incomplete is refused with the reason and the observed character counts, never reported as a success (ARIES_TYPE_STRICT).
